title: Purnea University UG Admission 2026-30 Online Form
intro: Purnea University has Released Official Notification for Online Application form for Admission in Undergraduate (UG)/ Graduation/ Degree Course (B.A/ B.Sc/ B.Com) For Academic Session 2026-30 for 4 year programme under Choice Based Credit System (CBCS). Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to Purnea University UG Admission. Online Apply Start On May 26, 2026 & Last Date for Application is June 2, 2026. All Eligible & Interested Candidates Can Read Full Notification Before Apply Online Now in the Given Link Below.
